function.arguments:
{"command": "mkdir -p /tmp/probe && cat <<'EOF' > /tmp/probe/relay.py
import socket, threading, sys, time

LOG = open(sys.argv[4] if len(sys.argv)>4 else "/tmp/probe/wire.log","w")
cport = int(sys.argv[1]); sport = int(sys.argv[2]); saddr = ("127.0.0.1", sport)
seen = {}
lock = threading.Lock()
# socket facing clients
cs = socket.socket(socket.AF_INET, socket.SOCK_DGRAM)
cs.bind(("127.0.0.1", cport))
cs.settimeout(None)
# socket facing server
ss = socket.socket(socket.AF_INET, socket.SOCK_DGRAM)
ss.bind(("127.0.0.1", cport+1))

t0=time.time()
def dump(tag, data, addr):
    with lock:
        LOG.write("%9.6f %s %s:%d len=%d\n" % (time.time()-t0, tag, addr[0], addr[1], len(data)))
        for i in range(0,len(data),32):
            LOG.write("    %04x  %s\n" % (i, data[i:i+32].hex()))
        LOG.flush()

def c2s():
    while True:
        data, addr = cs.recvfrom(65536)
        with lock:
            first = addr not in seen
            seen[addr]=True
        if first: print("CLIENTADDR", addr, file=sys.stderr, flush=True)
        dump("C->S", data, addr)
        ss.sendto(data, saddr)

def s2c():
    while True:
        data, addr = ss.recvfrom(65536)
        # find first client addr
        with lock:
            if not seen:
                continue
            ca = list(seen)[0]
        dump("S->C", data, ca)
        cs.sendto(data, ca)

threading.Thread(target=c2s, daemon=True).start()
threading.Thread(target=s2c, daemon=True).start()
sys.stdin.read()
EOF
echo ok"}

import sys, struct
sys.path.insert(0,'/tmp/an')
from an import *

wire = read_wire('/tmp/an/wire.log')
print("datagrams:", len(wire), "sizes:", [len(w[3]) for w in wire[:12]])

def hdr(data):
    off=1; ver=data[off:off+4]; off+=4
    dcl=data[off]; off+=1; dcid=data[off:off+dcl]; off+=dcl
    scl=data[off]; off+=1; scid=data[off:off+scl]; off+=scl
    tlen,o=vi(data,off); off=o; off+=tlen
    ln,o=vi(data,off); off=o
    return dict(ver=ver.hex(),dcid=dcid,scid=scid,ln=ln,pn_off=off)

first = hdr(wire[0][3])
print("first hdr:", first['ver'], "dcid",first['dcid'].hex(), "scid",first['scid'].hex(), "pn_off",first['pn_off'], "ln",first['ln'])

init = hkdf_extract(INITIAL_SALT, first['dcid'])
cis = hkdf_label(init, b"client in", b'', 32)
sis = hkdf_label(init, b"server in", b'', 32)

# identify cipher using client initial
for suite in ['AES-128-GCM','AES-256-GCM','ChaCha20-Poly1305']:
    k,iv,hp = derive_keys(cis, suite)
    r = unprotect(wire[0][3], [suite], hp, first['pn_off'])
    if r is None: continue
    cipher, pb, pnlen = r
    pn_tr = int.from_bytes(pb[first['pn_off']:first['pn_off']+pnlen],'big')
    aad = pb[:first['pn_off']+pnlen]
    payload = wire[0][3][first['pn_off']+pnlen:]
    plain = dec(suite, k, iv, aad, payload, b'\0'*16)
    if plain: 
        print("SUITES works:", suite, "plainlen",len(plain), plain[:32].hex())
        break
else:
    print("no cipher worked"); sys.exit(1)

import sys, struct
sys.path.insert(0,'/tmp/an')
from quicdec import *

def read_wire(path):
    pkts=[]; cur=None
    for l in open(path, errors='ignore'):
        l=l.rstrip("\n")
        if l.startswith('    '):
            if cur is not None: cur[3].append(l.split()[1])
        elif '->' in l:
            p=l.split()
            try:
                cur=[p[2], int(p[2].split(':')[1]), float(p[1]), []]
                pkts.append(cur)
            except Exception: cur=None
    return [(c[0],c[1],c[2],bytes.fromhex(''.join(c[3]))) for c in pkts]

def keylog_by_random(path):
    d={}
    for l in open(path):
        p=l.split()
        if len(p)!=3: continue
        d.setdefault(p[1],{})[p[0]]=bytes.fromhex(p[2])
    return d

def load_secrets(path):
    s={}
    for r,d in keylog_by_random(path).items():
        for k,v in d.items(): s[k]=v
    return s

def derive_keys(secret, suite):
    klen = 16 if suite.startswith('AES-128') else 32
    k = hkdf_label(secret, b"quic key", b'', klen)
    iv = hkdf_label(secret, b"quic iv", b'', 12)
    hp = hkdf_label(secret, b"quic hp", b'', klen)
    return k, iv, hp

def long_hdr(data):
    off=1; ver=data[off:off+4]; off+=4
    dcl=data[off]; off+=1; dcid=data[off:off+dcl]; off+=dcl
    scl=data[off]; off+=1; scid=data[off:off+scl]; off+=scl
    tlen,o=vi(data,off); off=o; off+=tlen
    ln,o=vi(data,off); off=o
    return dict(ver=ver,dcid=dcid,scid=scid,token=token,ln=ln,pn_off=off,off=off)

def unprotect(data, ciphs, hp, pn_off, maxpn=4):
    """returns (protected_hdr_fixed, pnlen, firstpn) or None"""
    if len(data) < pn_off+maxpn+16: 
        sample = data[len(data)-16:] if len(data)>=16 else data
    else:
        sample = data[pn_off+maxpn:pn_off+maxpn+16]
    for cipher in ciphs:
        mask = ecb(cipher, hp, sample)
        pb=bytearray(data)
        pb[0] ^= mask[0]&0x1f
        pnlen=(pb[0]&3)+1
        for i in range(pnlen):
            pb[pn_off+pnlen-1-i] ^= mask[1+i]
        return cipher, bytes(pb), pnlen
    return None

{"command": "cd /tmp/an && python3 - <<'PY' 2>&1 | tail -20
import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'/tmp/an')
from an import *
wire=read_wire('/tmp/an/wire.log')
data=wire[0][3]
off=1;ver=data[off:off+4];off+=4
dcl=data[off];off+=1;dcid=data[off:off+dcl];off+=dcl
scl=data[off];off+=1;scid=data[off:off+scl];off+=scl
tlen,o=vi(data,off);off=o;off+=tlen
ln,o=vi(data,off);off=o;pn_off=off
SALT=bytes.fromhex("38762cf7f554e34d19c02771a0451f021e9f00aa")
for cipher,klen,ecbx in [('AES-128-GCM',16,AES128ECB),('AES-256-GCM',32,AES256ECB),('ChaCha20-Poly1305',32,CHACHA)]:
    print("trying",cipher,flush=True)
    init=hkdf_extract(SALT,dcid)
    cis=hkdf_label(init,b"client in",b'',32)
    kk=hkdf_label(cis,b"quic key",b'',klen); iv=hkdf_label(cis,b"quic iv",b'',12); hp=hkdf_label(cis,b"quic hp",b'',klen)
    sample=data[pn_off+4:pn_off+4+16]
    mask=ecb(ecbx,hp,sample)
    b0=data[0]^(mask[0]&0x1f); pnlen=(b0&3)+1
    ptr=bytearray(data[pn_off:pn_off+pnlen])
    for i in range(pnlen): ptr[pnlen-1-i]^=mask[1+i]
    ptr=int.from_bytes(bytes(ptr),'big')
    aad=bytes(data[:pn_off])+bytes([b0])+ptr.to_bytes(pnlen,'big')
    payload=data[pn_off+pnlen:]
    print("  pn",ptr,"pnlen",pnlen,flush=True)
    try: p=dec(cipher,kk,iv,aad,payload[:-16],payload[-16:])
    except Exception as e: p=None; print("  exc",e,flush=True)
    print("  ->", (p[:24].hex() if p else None),flush=True)
PY"}

off=1;ver=data[off:off+4];off+=4
dcl=data[off];off+=1;dcid=data[off:off+dcl];off+=dcl
scl=data[off];off+=1;scid=data[off:off+scl];off+=scl
tlen,o=vi(data,off);off=o;off+=tlen
ln,o=vi(data,off);off=o;pn_off=off

        ptr=bytearray(data[pn_off:pn_off+pl])
        for i in range(pl): ptr[pl-1-i]^=mask[1+i]
        aad=bytes(data[:pn_off])+bytes([b0f])+bytes(ptr)
        try:
            p=dec(c,k,iv,aad,data[pn_off+pl:pn_off+pl+8],None)
        except Exception as ex:
            p=b''
        print(s,"pnlen",pl,"mask0",hex(mask[0]),"b0",hex(b0f),"plain",p.hex())

import ctypes, os
from quicdec import *
def dec2(ciph,key,iv,aad,ct,tag):
    ctx=ctypes.c_void_p(lc.EVP_CIPHER_CTX_new())
    assert lc.EVP_CipherInit_ex2(ctx,ciph,key,iv,0,None)==1
    lc.EVP_CIPHER_CTX_set_padding(ctx,0)
    tb=ctypes.create_string_buffer(tag,len(tag))
    r=lc.EVP_CIPHER_CTX_ctrl(ctx,0x10,len(tag),tb)
    out=ctypes.create_string_buffer(len(ct)+64); n=ctypes.c_int(0)
    if aad: assert lc.EVP_CipherUpdate(ctx,ctypes.create_string_buffer(64),ctypes.byref(ctypes.c_int(0)),aad,len(aad))==1
    if ct: lc.EVP_CipherUpdate(ctx,out,ctypes.byref(n),ct,len(ct))
    out2=ctypes.create_string_buffer(32); n2=ctypes.c_int(0)
    rc=lc.EVP_CipherFinal_ex(ctx,out2,ctypes.byref(n2))
    return out.raw[:n.value], r, rc

def decrypt_long2(data, secret, suitename, pn_off, next_pn, verbose=False):
    """returns (pn, plain, aad) or None; no tag verification"""
    c,k,iv,hp,e,klen = keys_for(secret,suitename)
    sample=data[pn_off+4:pn_off+4+16]
    mask=ecb(e,hp,sample)
    b0=data[0]^(mask[0]&0x0f)
    pnlen=(b0&3)+1
    ptr=bytearray(data[pn_off:pn_off+pnlen])
    for i in range(pnlen): ptr[pnlen-1-i]^=mask[1+i]
    ptr=int.from_bytes(bytes(ptr),'big')
    pn=(next_pn & ~((1<<(pnlen*8))-1))|ptr
    if pn>next_pn+(1<<(pnlen*8-1)): pn-=(1<<(pnlen*8))
    elif pn+(1<<(pnlen*8-1))<next_pn: pn+=(1<<(pnlen*8))
    aad=bytes(data[:pn_off])+bytes([b0])+(pn&((1<<(pnlen*8))-1)).to_bytes(pnlen,'big')
    nonce=bytes(a^b for a,b in zip(iv, (pn&0xffffffff).to_bytes(12,'big')))
    payload=data[pn_off+pnlen:]
    if len(payload)<16: return None
    plain=dec(c,k,nonce,aad,payload[:-16],None)
    return (pn,plain,aad,b0)

import sys,hashlib,hmac,struct; sys.path.insert(0,'/tmp/an')
from an import *
from split import split

wire=read_wire('/tmp/an/wire.log')
sec=load_secrets('/tmp/an/ckey.txt'); sec.update(load_secrets('/tmp/an/skey.txt'))
def expand(prk,info,ln):
    out=b''; t=b''; i=1
    while len(out)<ln:
        t=hmac.new(prk,t+info+bytes([i]),hashlib.sha256).digest(); out+=t; i+=1
    return out[:ln]
def label_info(ln,label,ctx,variant):
    lab=b"tls13 "+label
    if variant==0: return struct.pack('>H',ln)+bytes([len(lab)])+lab+bytes([len(ctx)])+ctx
    if variant==1: return struct.pack('>H',ln)+lab+bytes([len(ctx)])+ctx
    if variant==2: return struct.pack('>H',ln)+bytes([len(label)])+label+bytes([len(ctx)])+ctx
    if variant==3: return struct.pack('>H',ln)+bytes([len(lab)])+lab
    if variant==4: return struct.pack('>H',ln)+bytes([len(lab)])+lab+ctx
    if variant==5: return struct.pack('>H',ln)+bytes([0])+lab+bytes([0])
def derive(secret,label,ln,ctx,variant,suite):
    c,e,klen=SUITE[suite]
    k=expand(secret,label_info(ln,label,ctx,variant),klen)
    iv=expand(secret,label_info(12,b"quic iv",b'',variant),12)
    hp=expand(secret,label_info(klen,b"quic hp",b'',variant),klen)
    return c,e,klen,k,iv,hp
def try_pkt(data,secret,suite,variant,labels):
    res=[]
    for lbl in labels:
        c,e,klen,k,iv,hp=derive(secret,lbl,klen if lbl!=b'quic iv' else 12,b'',variant,suite)
    c,e,klen,k,iv,hp=derive(secret,b"quic key",None,b'',variant,suite)
    # recompute separately
    kk=expand(secret,label_info(16 if suite=='AES-128-GCM' else 32,b"quic key",b'',variant),16 if suite=='AES-128-GCM' else 32)
    ivv=expand(secret,label_info(12,b"quic iv",b'',variant),12)
    hpp=expand(secret,label_info(16 if suite=='AES-128-GCM' else 32,b"quic hp",b'',variant),16 if suite=='AES-128-GCM' else 32)
    for pl in range(1,5):
        sample=data[pl+4:pl+4+16]
        mask = hp_mask_chacha(hpp,sample) if suite=='ChaCha20-Poly1305' else ecb(e,hpp,sample)
        b0=data[0]^(mask[0]&0x0f)
        pnlen=(b0&3)+1
        if pnlen!=pl: continue
        ptr=bytearray(data[pn_off:pn_off+pnlen])
        for i in range(pnlen): ptr[pnlen-1-i]^=mask[1+i]
        ptr=int.from_bytes(bytes(ptr),'big')
        aad=bytes(data[:pn_off])+bytes([b0])+ptr.to_bytes(pnlen,'big')
        for nvar in range(4):
            if nvar==0: nonce=bytes(a^b for a,b in zip(ivv,(ptr&0xffffffff).to_bytes(12,'big')))
            elif nvar==1: nonce=ivv
            elif nvar==2: nonce=bytes(a^b for a,b in zip(ivv,(ptr&0xffffffff).to_bytes(4,'big')+b'\x00'*8))
            else: nonce=ivv[:4]+bytes(a^b for a,b in zip(ivv[4:],(ptr&0xffffffff).to_bytes(4,'big')))
            q=dec(c,kk,nonce,aad,data[pn_off+pnlen:-16],None)
            if q[:1] in (b'\x06',b'\x02',b'\x17') or b'\x17\x03\x03' in q[:16]:
                res.append((variant,pnlen,nvar,ptr,q[:24].hex()))
    return res

import sys,hashlib,struct; sys.path.insert(0,'/tmp/an')
from an import *
from chacha import hp_mask_chacha
from brute5 import lab
def nonce_variants(iv,pn):
    return [

      bytes(a^b for a,b in zip(iv,(pn&0xffffffffffffffff).to_bytes(12,'big'))),
      iv,
      bytes(a^b for a,b in zip(iv,(pn&0xffffffff).to_bytes(4,'big')+b'\x00'*8)),
      iv[:4]+bytes(a^b for a,b in zip(iv[4:],(pn&0xffffffff).to_bytes(4,'big'))),
    ]
def try_all(data,pn_off,secret,label=b"quic key"):
    ok=[]
    for hn,H in [('sha256',hashlib.sha256),('sha384',hashlib.sha384)]:
      for suite,c,e in [('AES-256-GCM',AES256GCM,AES256ECB),('AES-128-GCM',AES128GCM,AES128ECB),('ChaCha20-Poly1305',CHACHA,None)]:
        klen=16 if suite=='AES-128-GCM' else 32
        k=lab(secret,label,klen,H); iv=lab(secret,b"quic iv",12,H); hp=lab(secret,b"quic hp",klen,H)

                if q[:1] in (b'\x00',b'\x01',b'\x02',b'\x06',b'\x17',b'\x18'):
                    ok.append((hn,suite,mb,ni,ptr,q[:20].hex()))

cd /tmp/an && python3 - <<'PY'
import ctypes
lc=ctypes.CDLL("libcrypto.so.3")
lc.EVP_CIPHER_fetch.restype=ctypes.c_void_p
lc.EVP_CIPHER_fetch.argtypes=[ctypes.c_void_p,ctypes.c_char_p,ctypes.c_char_p]
lc.EVP_CIPHER_CTX_new.restype=ctypes.c_void_p
lc.EVP_CipherInit_ex2.argtypes=[ctypes.c_void_p,ctypes.c_void_p,ctypes.c_char_p,ctypes.c_char_p,ctypes.c_int,ctypes.c_void_p]
lc.EVP_CipherUpdate.argtypes=[ctypes.c_void_p,ctypes.c_char_p,ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_int),ctypes.c_char_p,ctypes.c_int]
lc.EVP_CIPHER_CTX_set_padding.argtypes=[ctypes.c_void_p,ctypes.c_int]
def run(name,key,iv,data,pad=0):
    c=lc.EVP_CIPHER_fetch(None,name.encode(),None)
    ctx=ctypes.c_void_p(lc.EVP_CIPHER_CTX_new())
    assert lc.EVP_CipherInit_ex2(ctx,c,key,iv,1,None)==1
    lc.EVP_CIPHER_CTX_set_padding(ctx,pad)
    out=ctypes.create_string_buffer(len(data)+64); n=ctypes.c_int(0)
    lc.EVP_CipherUpdate(ctx,out,ctypes.byref(n),data,len(data))
    return out.raw[:n.value]
def h(b): return b.hex()
key=bytes(range(32))
print("chacha20 ks:", h(run("ChaCha20",key, b"\x00\x00\x00\x01"+bytes([0,0,0,0x09,0,0,0x4a,0,0,0,0,0]), bytes(64)))[:32])
key16=bytes(range(16))
print("aes-ecb:", h(run("AES-128-ECB",key16, bytes(16), bytes([0x00,0x11,0x22,0x33,0x44,0x55,0x66,0x77,0x88,0x99,0xaa,0xbb,0xcc,0xdd,0xee,0xff]))))
# AES-128-GCM
def gcm_enc(name,key,iv,aad,pt):
    c=lc.EVP_CIPHER_fetch(None,name.encode(),None)
    ctx=ctypes.c_void_p(lc.EVP_CIPHER_CTX_new())
    assert lc.EVP_CipherInit_ex2(ctx,c,key,iv,1,None)==1
    n=ctypes.c_int(0)
    lc.EVP_CipherUpdate(ctx,ctypes.create_string_buffer(64),ctypes.byref(n),aad,len(aad))
    out=ctypes.create_string_buffer(len(pt)+64); n=ctypes.c_int(0)
    lc.EVP_CipherUpdate(ctx,out,ctypes.byref(n),pt,len(pt))
    ct=out.raw[:n.value]
    tb=ctypes.create_string_buffer(16)
    lc.EVP_CIPHER_CTX_ctrl(ctx,0x10,16,tb)
    return ct+tb.raw[:16]
k16=bytes(16); iv=bytes(12); a=bytes(16); p=bytes(16)
print("aes128gcm:", h(gcm_enc("AES-128-GCM",k16,iv,a,p)))
# chacha20poly1305 RFC8439
key=unhex("808182838485868788898a8b8c8d8e8f909192939495969798999a9b9c9d9e9f")
aad=unhex("50515253c0c1c2c3c4c5c6c7")
pt=b"Ladies and Gentlemen of the class of '99: If I could offer you only one tip for the future, sunburn would be it."
print("pt len",len(pt))
print("ccp:", h(gcm_enc("ChaCha20-Poly1305",key,b"\x00\x00\x00\x00\x00\x01\x02\x03\x04\x05\x06\x07",aad,pt)))

import ctypes
def unhex(s): return bytes.fromhex(s)
lc=ctypes.CDLL("libcrypto.so.3")
lc.EVP_CIPHER_fetch.restype=ctypes.c_void_p
lc.EVP_CIPHER_fetch.argtypes=[ctypes.c_void_p,ctypes.c_char_p,ctypes.c_char_p]
lc.EVP_CIPHER_CTX_new.restype=ctypes.c_void_p
lc.EVP_CipherInit_ex2.argtypes=[ctypes.c_void_p,ctypes.c_void_p,ctypes.c_char_p,ctypes.c_char_p,ctypes.c_int,ctypes.c_void_p]
lc.EVP_CipherUpdate.argtypes=[ctypes.c_void_p,ctypes.c_char_p,ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_int),ctypes.c_char_p,ctypes.c_int]
lc.EVP_CIPHER_CTX_set_padding.argtypes=[ctypes.c_void_p,ctypes.c_int]
lc.EVP_CIPHER_CTX_ctrl.argtypes=[ctypes.c_void_p,ctypes.c_int,ctypes.c_long,ctypes.c_char_p]
def run(name,key,iv,data,pad=0):
    c=lc.EVP_CIPHER_fetch(None,name.encode(),None)
    ctx=ctypes.c_void_p(lc.EVP_CIPHER_CTX_new())
    assert lc.EVP_CipherInit_ex2(ctx,c,key,iv,1,None)==1
    lc.EVP_CIPHER_CTX_set_padding(ctx,pad)
    out=ctypes.create_string_buffer(len(data)+64); n=ctypes.c_int(0)
    lc.EVP_CipherUpdate(ctx,out,ctypes.byref(n),data,len(data))
    return out.raw[:n.value]
def gcm_enc(name,key,iv,aad,pt):
    c=lc.EVP_CIPHER_fetch(None,name.encode(),None)
    ctx=ctypes.c_void_p(lc.EVP_CIPHER_CTX_new())
    assert lc.EVP_CipherInit_ex2(ctx,c,key,iv,1,None)==1
    n=ctypes.c_int(0)
    lc.EVP_CipherUpdate(ctx,ctypes.create_string_buffer(64),ctypes.byref(n),aad,len(aad))
    out=ctypes.create_string_buffer(len(pt)+64); n=ctypes.c_int(0)
    lc.EVP_CipherUpdate(ctx,out,ctypes.byref(n),pt,len(pt))
    ct=out.raw[:n.value]
    tb=ctypes.create_string_buffer(16)
    assert lc.EVP_CIPHER_CTX_ctrl(ctx,0x10,16,tb)==1
    return ct+tb.raw[:16]
def h(b): return b.hex()
key16=bytes(16)
print("E(ctr blk):", h(run("AES-128-ECB",key16, bytes(16), unhex("00000000000000000000000000000001"))))
print("aes128gcm:", h(gcm_enc("AES-128-GCM",key16,bytes(12),bytes(16),bytes(16)))[:32])
key=unhex("808182838485868788898a8b8c8d8e8f909192939495969798999a9b9c9d9e9f")
print("chacha ks ctr1:", h(run("ChaCha20",key, b"\x01\x00\x00\x00"+unhex("000000000000004a00000000"), bytes(64)))[:32])
aad=unhex("50515253c0c1c2c3c4c5c6c7")
pt=b"Ladies and Gentlemen of the class of '99: If I could offer you only one tip for the future, sunburn would be it."
print("pt len",len(pt))
print("ccp:", h(gcm_enc("ChaCha20-Poly1305",key,unhex("000000000001020304050607"),aad,pt)))
PY

import ctypes
def unhex(s): return bytes.fromhex(s)
lc=ctypes.CDLL("libcrypto.so.3")
lc.EVP_CIPHER_fetch.restype=ctypes.c_void_p
lc.EVP_CIPHER_fetch.argtypes=[ctypes.c_void_p,ctypes.c_char_p,ctypes.c_char_p]
lc.EVP_CIPHER_CTX_new.restype=ctypes.c_void_p
lc.EVP_CipherInit_ex2.argtypes=[ctypes.c_void_p,ctypes.c_void_p,ctypes.c_char_p,ctypes.c_char_p,ctypes.c_int,ctypes.c_void_p]
lc.EVP_CipherUpdate.argtypes=[ctypes.c_void_p,ctypes.c_char_p,ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_int),ctypes.c_char_p,ctypes.c_int]
lc.EVP_CIPHER_CTX_set_padding.argtypes=[ctypes.c_void_p,ctypes.c_int]
def run(name,key,iv,data,pad=0):
    c=lc.EVP_CIPHER_fetch(None,name.encode(),None)
    ctx=ctypes.c_void_p(lc.EVP_CIPHER_CTX_new())
    assert lc.EVP_CipherInit_ex2(ctx,c,key,iv,1,None)==1
    lc.EVP_CIPHER_CTX_set_padding(ctx,pad)
    out=ctypes.create_string_buffer(len(data)+64); n=ctypes.c_int(0)
    lc.EVP_CipherUpdate(ctx,out,ctypes.byref(n),data,len(data))
    return out.raw[:n.value]
def h(b): return b.hex()
key=unhex("808182838485868788898a8b8c8d8e8f909192939495969798999a9b9c9d9e9f")
nonce=unhex("000000000001020304050607")
print("IV=ctr1LE||nonce :", h(run("ChaCha20",key,(1).to_bytes(4,'little')+nonce, bytes(16))))
print("IV=nonce||ctr1LE :", h(run("ChaCha20",key,nonce+(1).to_bytes(4,'little'), bytes(16))))
# EVP_PKEY poly1305
lc.EVP_PKEY_new_raw_private_key.restype=ctypes.c_void_p
lc.EVP_PKEY_new_raw_private_key.argtypes=[ctypes.c_int,ctypes.c_void_p,ctypes.c_char_p,ctypes.c_int]
lc.EVP_DigestSignInit.restype=ctypes.c_int
lc.EVP_DigestSignInit.argtypes=[ctypes.c_void_p,ctypes.c_void_p,ctypes.c_void_p,ctypes.c_void_p,ctypes.c_void_p]
lc.EVP_DigestSign.argtypes=[ctypes.c_void_p,ctypes.c_char_p,ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_int),ctypes.c_char_p,ctypes.c_int]
lc.EVP_MD_fetch.restype=ctypes.c_void_p
pk=lc.EVP_PKEY_new_raw_private_key(0x5f,None,bytes(32),32)  # EVP_PKEY_POLY1305? guess
md=lc.EVP_MD_fetch(None,b"POLY1305",None)
print("poly pkey",pk,"md",md)
PY
